actual: Root-level tracked Python one-shot scripts such as create_tables.py, run_migration.py, and export_index_tdx_to_qlib_bin.py are historical entrypoints already identified by legacy inventory as deprecated/delete-candidate. They increase root clutter and may confuse Codex/Claude scans. First cleanup should only remove confirmed low-risk one-shot legacy scripts that have no current runtime imports, while preserving active root modules still imported by routers/services. Acceptance: remove or archive only the safe first batch, keep root/main clean, no production runtime/DB touch, run targeted import/static validation and root legacy inventory check.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
